description:
## [1.2.0](https://github.com/TahmidSummy/proxy-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-11-04)

### ✨ New features

* **SOCKS5 proxy support.** You can now route the app through a SOCKS5 proxy, as well as HTTP and HTTPS proxies.
  * Optional username and password (standard SOCKS5 username/password login).
  * **DNS stays on the proxy.** Website names are sent to the SOCKS5 server unresolved, so your phone never looks up the sites the app visits.
  * Only TCP is used. That's all the app needs, because QUIC/UDP is already off whenever a proxy is set.
* **Proxy type setting.** The old "HTTPS (TLS) proxy" on/off switch is replaced by a three-way choice: **HTTPS** (encrypted connection to the proxy), **HTTP** (plain) or **SOCKS5**.
  * **In the app:** long-press the Reddit icon → **Proxy settings** → Proxy type.
  * **In Morphe Manager:** a **Proxy type** dropdown in the patch options.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **Test connection understands SOCKS5** and explains what's wrong in plain words:
  * wrong username or password;
  * the proxy needs a login;
  * the server isn't a SOCKS5 proxy;
  * the proxy couldn't reach the website (network unreachable, host unreachable, connection refused, and so on).
* **More reliable with SOCKS5 servers that have broken IPv6.** Some servers look up a website's IPv6 address even though they can't actually use IPv6, then answer "host unreachable". This makes images and videos fail at random. The app now retries those connections automatically (twice), and logs each retry. If it keeps happening, the error message suggests setting the server to prefer IPv4, which is the proper fix.
* **Your settings carry over.** If you're updating from 1.1.0 and set "HTTPS (TLS) proxy" on or off in the app, it's kept as **HTTPS** or **HTTP**.

### ⚠️ Things to know

* **SOCKS5 isn't encrypted** between your phone and the proxy. Your app traffic inside the tunnel is still HTTPS, but your proxy login and the names of the sites you visit can be seen on the network path. If that matters to you, use an **HTTPS** proxy, which protects both. The settings screen labels SOCKS5 as "(not encrypted)".
* **The "HTTPS (TLS) proxy" patch option is replaced by "Proxy type".** If you set that option in Morphe Manager (rather than in the app), check it the next time you patch. It defaults to HTTPS. Proxy settings saved inside the app aren't affected.

### ✅ Tested

Tested with Reddit 2026.40.0 on an Android 15 emulator, watching every connection the app made:

* **SOCKS5** with a real SOCKS5 server and with a local test server:
  * the feed, images and video load through the proxy, with nothing going direct;
  * all destinations were sent to the proxy by name, with no lookups on the device;
  * a wrong password gives a clear error.
* **HTTPS** proxy re-tested after the change, with everything going through the proxy and no errors.
* **"Run without proxy"** and the leak fixes from 1.1.0 are unchanged.

([ff1227f](https://github.com/TahmidSummy/proxy-patches/commit/ff1227f049a7d4c7644d4390acdff0b2d3cf5dde))
